title: Dispatch Notice Rates for Mobile In-Home Collection Trips
content:
## Dispatch notice rates — Specimen Collection Appointments

The trip charge of a Mobile In-Home Collection Visit is multiplied by a dispatch notice rate set by how far ahead the visit was booked. The notice is the number of calendar days from the booking date to the appointment date, both as shown on the visit record.

| Notice (calendar days from booking date to appointment date) | Rate | Name |
|---|---|---|
| Three days or fewer | 1.15 | Short-notice rate |
| Four to 20 days | 1.00 | Standard rate |
| 21 days or more | 0.95 | Planned-route rate |

**Clause.** A visit booked three days or fewer ahead is charged at the short-notice rate of 1.15, a visit booked 21 days or more ahead is charged at the planned-route rate of 0.95, and a visit booked four to 20 days ahead is charged at the standard rate of 1.00.

### Counting the notice

The notice counts calendar days, not hours: a visit booked on the 3rd of a month for the 6th of the same month has a notice of 3 days; for the 7th, 4 days.

### Edges of each band (hypothetical bookings)

| Notice | Band | Rate |
|---|---|---|
| 2 days | Three days or fewer | 1.15 |
| 3 days | Three days or fewer | 1.15 |
| 4 days | Four to 20 days | 1.00 |
| 20 days | Four to 20 days | 1.00 |
| 21 days | 21 days or more | 0.95 |
| 40 days | 21 days or more | 0.95 |
